subject: Signer routing & purchase metadata alignment for Mediform activation
snippet: Need to confirm signer authority and PO field mapping before we flip Mediform to live in Coupa/Ariba.
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Susan Jenkins <susan.jenkins@mediform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signer routing & purchase metadata alignment for Mediform activation

Hi Susan,

Thanks for the legal docs—appreciate the quick turnaround. Before we start signature routing and flip the vendor to "Active" in the procurement portals, a couple of items we need to lock down so Ops can map PO and remit fields correctly: 

1) Signer authority: who at Mediform will sign the Order Form? We need the name, title, and whether they can sign up to $1M annually (this affects our signer routing).

2) PO acknowledgement window: please confirm Mediform's standard PO ack SLA. We typically require a 2-business-day ack; if you need longer, say so now.

3) PO metadata: Ops needs the exact field you will populate for these items:
   - Invoice remit-to (company name + remit address)
   - Tax/VAT ID (format)
   - Preferred PO number format (alphanumeric / max length)

4) Ariba vs Coupa: are you enrolling via Ariba network or do you prefer Coupa supplier registration? If Ariba, vendor ID is helpful; if Coupa, confirm the email used for registration.

Attaching the current Order Form draft for reference (OrderForm_Draft_v1.docx). Marissa — legal has a quick redline pass; can you drop high-level comments so Susan knows which clauses are blockers for activation?

Susan — once we have these details, Kimberly will provision the vendor record and set up the PO routing. If DocuSign is easiest, we can send the Order Form that way.

Cheers,
Rishi
Head of GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_Draft_v1.docx (docx)

From: Susan Jenkins <susan.jenkins@mediform.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mediform.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signer routing & purchase metadata alignment for Mediform activation

Hi Rishi — thanks, sending answers inline: 

1) Signer: I (Susan Jenkins) am VP Finance and authorized to sign up to $1.2M annually. If a counter-signature from our GC is required for >$1M we can route, but for this arrangement I can sign.

2) PO ack: We typically acknowledge within 1-3 business days; 2 business days is fine.

3) PO metadata:
   - Remit-to: Mediform Health LLC, 420 Meridian Ave, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94401
   - Tax ID: EIN 27-1234567 (SSN not applicable)
   - PO number format: alphanumeric, up to 12 characters (example: MEDF-20270408-045)

4) Registration: We're planning to enroll in Ariba. Current Ariba vendor ID is 50021477. Our Coupa registration (if needed) would be under vendor+redwood@mediform.com.

DocuSign is fine — happy to sign electronically.

I attached our vendor profile export (VendorProfile.csv) with primary contacts. Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Susan
VP Finance, Mediform Health

Attachment: VendorProfile.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Susan Jenkins <susan.jenkins@mediform.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Signer routing & purchase metadata alignment for Mediform activation

Folks — quick legal pass attached (OrderForm_redline_v2.pdf). High-level callouts: 

- Payment terms: Legal pushed Net30 as standard. Sales had previously discussed Net45 — can Ops accept Net30 for the first 90 days then revisit?
- Liability cap: legal kept our standard cap; Mediform asked to increase — tracker shows they requested 2x our default. That will need executive approval if we concede.
- Data handling: no major changes but we want explicit logging retention to match our platform policies (30 days log retention for request metadata).

Operational asks for vendor onboarding: 
- Please ensure "PO acknowledgment" field in Ariba maps back to our internal "po_acknowledged_at" timestamp. If Mediform cannot populate the acknowledgement flag, Ops needs to start a polling window for 48 hours post-PO creation.
- Ensure "remit_to.tax_id" maps to our tax matching flow. If Ariba uses free-text we need a canonical EIN field.

Susan — if you can accept Net30 for the initial term, that would avoid a legal escalation. Also confirm whether the signees are comfortable with DocuSign (we prefer electronic signature traceability).

Marissa
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_redline_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Thanks Marissa & Susan. Quick summary and next steps so Ops has a clean checklist: 

- Signer: Susan Jenkins (VP Finance) confirmed authority up to $1.2M — Kimberly, please add Susan as primary signer. If PO > $1.2M, route to GC (Susan will supply GC contact when needed).
- PO ack: Mediform confirms 2 business day ack window — Ops will set polling for 48 hours if no acknowledgement flag received.
- PO metadata: format confirmed (alphanumeric up to 12 chars). Kimberly/Ops to map Ariba field ARIBA:PO_NUMBER -> internal:po_number and ARIBA:REMIT_TO_TAXID -> remit_to.tax_id.
- Payment terms: Susan prefers Net45; Marissa requested Net30. Susan — can you accept Net30 for first 90 days to keep this moving? If not, we'll need to route a one-off approval.

Kimberly — please coordinate provisioning in Coupa and Ariba as a dual-path (Mediform has Ariba ID 50021477; also set up the Coupa record under vendor+redwood@mediform.com). Target go-live: 2027-04-20 EOD if we get confirmations.

Also linking the onboarding folder and HubSpot deal (see links). I'll send the DocuSign envelope once legal signals green.

Thanks — R
Rishi
Head of GTM Ops
